_note: Leakage-controlled symptom KB v2 (plan 10.2/10.4). Classes are grouped into FAMILIES that share deliberately ambiguous vocabulary, so confusable classes (e.g. the two lesion/spot diseases, the two boll classes, the two pests) are hard to separate from text alone. Generation leans on family + shared vocabulary and only sometimes adds a single class-specific detail, mirroring vague real-world farmer descriptions. Class names never appear in the text.
